annotations.title: Italian Patent Box 110% Superdeduction & Tax Shield Auditor

description:
[Italian Patent Box 110% superdeduction & tax shield auditor. Deterministic calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Calculates the 110% superdeduction on qualifying R&D expenses under the Italian New Patent Box (Art. 6 D.L. 146/2021) for patents, copyrighted software, and registered designs, computing IRES (24%) and IRAP (3.9%) tax savings and the 8-year recapture mechanism.
Usage: Use this tool to evaluate corporate tax savings and penalty protection documentation shields for proprietary IP assets.
Returns: JSON object with { companyName: string, ipAssetType: string, isEligibleForNewPatentBox: boolean, superdeductionRatePercent: number, fiscalSummary: object, penaltyProtectionActive: boolean }.

hasDocumentaryDossierForPenaltyProtectio.description: Whether the formal compliance dossier has been prepared for penalty protection ex Art. 6 c. 6

ipRegistrationTitleOrProtocol.description: Patent application number, copyright registration ID, or design title

isRecapturePrior8YearsApplicable.description: Whether to apply the 8-year lookback recapture mechanism upon IP grant

qualifyingExpenses.description: Array of annual qualifying R&D expense allocations

depreciationLaboratoryEquipmentEur.description: Depreciation of R&D laboratory equipment and software licenses in EUR

externalResearchContractsEur.description: Extra-muros research contracts with universities, institutes, or third parties in EUR

fiscalYear.description: Fiscal year in which expenses were incurred

internalPersonnelCostsEur.description: Internal researcher/developer gross employment costs in EUR

technicalConsultingAndMaterialsEur.description: Technical consulting and laboratory materials in EUR

yearOfIpGrantOrRegistration.description: Fiscal year in which IP asset was granted / registered
